style: 岩彩裂壁 · 墨势入场

shot_plan.elevation: slightly high, looking down about 12 degrees from the envoy's side of the map
shot_plan.azimuth: near-frontal three-quarter view; the torso faces the map while the eyes cut toward the viewer
shot_plan.scale: 28 mm wide medium-wide composition; the foreshortened arm and map create depth without hiding the face
shot_plan.interaction: the viewer is the envoy on the opposite edge of the map and witnesses the irreversible seal impact
shot_plan.motion: radial impact travels from the seal across the six-state map toward the frame edges
shot_plan.foreground: cracked mineral map, seal impact and scattered bamboo slips

palette_plan.dominant: ink-black robes, earthen ochre wall, broken stone-blue and muted six-state mineral colors
palette_plan.gold: G3 approved-anchor density, roughly 8–12 percent, concentrated in map fissures, robe trim and impact fragments
palette_plan.light: dry neutral daylight with a severe bronze warmth at the seal impact
palette_plan.surface: large cracked mural plates and sharp radial gold fractures

shot_plan.elevation: human eye level from inside the dim Weiyang corridor
shot_plan.azimuth: front three-quarter approach as the emperor steps through the opening and releases the curtain behind his left shoulder
shot_plan.scale: 46 mm full three-quarter environmental figure; crown, face, both hands and planted stride remain readable
shot_plan.roll: level wet-stone horizon with a soft vertical curtain boundary
shot_plan.interaction: the viewer is a senior official inside the hall whose polished report is being silently tested against the real Chang'an street outside
shot_plan.motion: the heavy curtain settles behind the emperor while fine rain and wet wheel tracks continue inward from the ordinary street
shot_plan.foreground: one small low oil lamp and curtain folds occupy the left edge; no table, report pile or hand enters the lens

palette_plan.dominant: cold rain blue-gray, soot-brown curtain and robe, undyed linen, wet stone and restrained oxidized bronze-green
palette_plan.gold: G0 no gold leaf, gilded trim, gold dust or yellow-gold glow
palette_plan.light: cold rainy street light on the face and threshold opposed by one very small muted oil-lamp rim
palette_plan.surface: heavy cloth folds, wet-stone reflections, broad carbon shadow fragments and thin flying-white rain

shot_plan.elevation: eye level inside an imperial campaign pavilion, with no low-angle hero distortion
shot_plan.azimuth: viewed from beside, not directly behind, a kneeling general; the emperor stands left of center in a strong right-facing three-quarter view so both eyes and most facial planes remain readable
shot_plan.scale: 45 mm waist-up medium shot with natural proportions; the emperor occupies about 58 percent of frame height and the foreground figure occupies less than 10 percent
shot_plan.interaction: the viewer stands beside the general receiving the authenticated imperial order, close enough to witness the tally but never blocking the ruler
shot_plan.motion: two long crimson-and-black ink routes diverge from the campaign map and travel away toward two distant Han cavalry columns on the Mobei horizon
shot_plan.foreground: only a narrow blurred sleeve edge and the corner of a blank wooden command tablet enter the lower-left; no foreground head, helmet or large hand
shot_plan.pose: stand fully upright with squared shoulders and a stable vertical spine; both elbows stay naturally bent close to the torso while both hands meet at chest height to align the two small halves of the bronze tiger tally, below the chin so the face remains unobstructed; keep both forearms inside the body silhouette; no pointing finger, no long reach, no leaning across the table and no twisting wrist

palette_plan.dominant: deep campaign crimson and iron-black against pale desert sand and a cold cobalt northern sky
palette_plan.gold: G0 no gold leaf, no gilding and no floating gold dust; the tiger tally and belt hardware are dark patinated bronze, never bright yellow or shiny gold
palette_plan.light: cold high-altitude daylight with a hard sand-colored horizon
palette_plan.surface: long horizontal wind-scoured ink streaks, broad crimson cloth planes and pale sand abrasion, not map-like cracking or black-gold speckling

shot_plan.elevation: eye level in a long ritual corridor, not from below
shot_plan.azimuth: left-facing three-quarter view with roughly seventy percent of the face readable; his body remains ritually aligned while his eyes glance sideways
shot_plan.scale: 50 mm medium shot with the figure off-center on the right third and no lens distortion
shot_plan.roll: 8-degree clockwise Dutch tilt that destabilizes the otherwise perfect ritual order
shot_plan.interaction: the viewer watches from between court ranks as the public image of a perfect Confucian restorer separates from the shadow of the usurping emperor
shot_plan.motion: a single coherent cast shadow travels diagonally across the Duke-of-Zhou mural while one grounded floor crack leads toward resting failed currencies; nothing is airborne
shot_plan.foreground: only two thin cropped court-robe edges frame the lower corners; every coin and measure rests on the floor with contact shadows

palette_plan.dominant: oxidized verdigris, chalk white, cold cyan-gray and dull brown bronze
palette_plan.gold: G0 near-absent, maximum 1 percent, only a dead tarnished line on ritual hardware; absolutely no floating gold dust
palette_plan.light: flat cold ritual light with a faint sickly green cast
palette_plan.surface: rigid geometric plaster seams interrupted by vertical bronze and currency fragments

shot_plan.elevation: ground-level tracking height beside the charging horse, looking up about 12 degrees
shot_plan.azimuth: clean side-on three-quarter view as horse and rider race from left to right
shot_plan.scale: 24 mm dynamic wide shot; the full horse neck, rider torso and breach remain legible
shot_plan.interaction: the viewer rides abreast inside the small Kunyang cavalry wedge
shot_plan.motion: rain, mane, mud and spear shafts slash laterally left-to-right past the viewer
shot_plan.foreground: a cropped wet horse ear and flying mud establish the neighboring rider's position

palette_plan.dominant: storm blue, charcoal rain, wet earth brown, lightning silver and one torn muted-red banner
palette_plan.gold: G0 no gold leaf; metallic accents are wet iron and lightning silver
palette_plan.light: blue-black thunderstorm split by a single white lightning flash
palette_plan.surface: wet pigment runs, mud splashes and rain-cut ink diagonals

shot_plan.elevation: from the top platform, looking down the rammed-earth stair at about 38 degrees
shot_plan.azimuth: front-left three-quarter view as he climbs directly toward the viewer and raises his eyes
shot_plan.scale: 35 mm medium-wide full-body shot; he occupies about 58 percent of the visual mass
shot_plan.roll: level horizon and one strict stair vanishing system
shot_plan.interaction: the viewer stands where Xiangguo's new court would receive him at the top of the final step
shot_plan.motion: his upward stride opposes the downward receding stair lines while one off-axis banner shadow cuts diagonally across the earth
shot_plan.foreground: only the rough lip of the top step frames the bottom edge; the old shackle remains small on the distant lowest landing

palette_plan.dominant: rammed-earth ochre, iron rust, coarse linen gray and heavy ink-black
palette_plan.gold: G0 no gold leaf or gilding
palette_plan.light: low dusty side light with ember-red rust highlights
palette_plan.surface: coarse scraped earth, worn stair edges, iron abrasion and one diagonal banner-shadow brush stroke

shot_plan.elevation: eye level at arm's length inside the besieged Taicheng shrine chamber
shot_plan.azimuth: front-left three-quarter view as the aged emperor raises his eyes directly toward the last attendant
shot_plan.scale: 55 mm tight medium shot from waist to head; the emperor occupies about 70 percent of the visual mass
shot_plan.roll: level and compressed, with one narrow lattice perspective behind him
shot_plan.interaction: the viewer is the attendant who has just handed him the final empty food bowl
shot_plan.motion: cold siege light cuts right-to-left across his face while beard tips, ash and a torn kasaya edge move in the same weak draft
shot_plan.foreground: no foreground hand or tray; the small empty bowl remains close to his chest inside his silhouette

palette_plan.dominant: cold ash-celadon, bone white, carbon black, dead oxblood red and narrow steel-blue
palette_plan.gold: G1 maximum 1 percent, only a sick tarnished remnant in the cracked Buddha halo; no gold on the emperor and no speckles
palette_plan.light: cold steel-blue siege daylight isolates the face against a charcoal shrine interior, with one dying oxblood lamp accent
palette_plan.surface: large matte chalk-mineral planes, carbon-ink fractures, dry ash and sparse scraped vermilion; no sepia wash or micro-speckle texture

shot_plan.elevation: chest-height viewpoint behind the Song envoy, looking upward only eight degrees toward the founding altar
shot_plan.azimuth: rear-left three-quarter body moving away while the compact ruler turns his broad round face back over his left shoulder
shot_plan.scale: 40 mm medium-wide shot from mid-thigh upward; the ruler occupies about 65 percent of frame height
shot_plan.roll: level altar horizon with a strong diagonal stair rise
shot_plan.interaction: the viewer is the Song envoy whose offered Han-style insignia has just been refused
shot_plan.motion: the ruler climbs away while the red cap-knot, white narrow sleeve and altar banners all snap sideways in the Helan wind
shot_plan.foreground: only the lower-left edge of the envoy's supported tray is visible, holding the rejected black crown and folded broad crimson robe

palette_plan.dominant: bone-white Tangut tunic and rammed earth, deep navy-black shadow, one carmine-red cap knot and tiny weathered turquoise accents
palette_plan.gold: G1 maximum 1 percent, only one worn line on the altar edge; no gold on costume, sky or frame
palette_plan.light: hard pale Hexi sun cuts the high nose and hawk eyes while banner shadows cross the white altar
palette_plan.surface: chalky bone-white planes, blocky carbon-ink fractures, narrow carmine wind strokes and restrained square woven motifs

shot_plan.elevation: camera almost at river-surface height among the front-rank officers, looking upward only twelve degrees
shot_plan.azimuth: front-left three-quarter dismounted ruler on the bank, his face and whip hand fully readable in the upper-right
shot_plan.scale: 28 mm wide medium shot with the ruler occupying about 58 percent of frame height and cold water filling the lower 45 percent
shot_plan.interaction: the viewer is a skeptical front-rank officer standing ankle-deep as the emperor challenges the river and fixes him with a confident gaze
shot_plan.motion: one continuous leather whip sweeps laterally above the water while orderly spear reflections fracture downward into ink-dark rout lines
shot_plan.foreground: rippling black-blue water and two cropped officer silhouettes at the extreme edges; no foreground hand or weapon points at the lens

palette_plan.dominant: cold river blue-gray, bruised imperial purple, oxidized spear silver, charcoal armor and deep liquid ink
palette_plan.gold: G1 maximum 1 percent, one thin worn line on a belt fitting only; the whip is black leather, not gold
palette_plan.light: cold reflected river light under a bruised gray sky
palette_plan.surface: watery mineral blooms, one broad lateral whip stroke and downward reflections breaking from disciplined lines into chaotic liquid ink

shot_plan.elevation: waist-height viewpoint just inside the Luoyang gate, parallel to the threshold
shot_plan.azimuth: clean left-to-right side profile stride with the young emperor turning his pale face only slightly toward the old guard-viewer
shot_plan.scale: 45 mm full three-quarter shot from boots to crown; the emperor occupies about 67 percent of frame height
shot_plan.roll: level architecture with one hard vertical gate-shadow division
shot_plan.interaction: the viewer is the old Xianbei guard inside the gate whom the emperor silently expects to follow into the new order
shot_plan.motion: his complete crimson wide sleeve and robe hem travel rightward while caravan dust and the strapped old riding coat recede left-to-right behind him
shot_plan.foreground: only a narrow blurred edge of the guard's old braid and indigo fur collar enters the far right; nothing blocks the emperor

palette_plan.dominant: pale Luoyang stone, deep indigo, muted celadon and restrained Han red
palette_plan.gold: G0 no gold leaf; use pale stone cracks and cloth contrast instead
palette_plan.light: clear soft city-gate daylight
palette_plan.surface: architectural plaster planes, streaming migration dust and long folded-cloth strokes

shot_plan.elevation: level human eye height on an unfinished Daxing inspection tower
shot_plan.azimuth: front-left three-quarter view with the ruler studying a plumb line held beside, never across, his face
shot_plan.scale: 85 mm intimate thigh-up environmental portrait; the emperor occupies about 72–78 percent of frame height
shot_plan.roll: strictly level with the plumb cord forming the dominant vertical
shot_plan.interaction: the viewer stands beside the imperial survey point and is silently responsible for whether the new order is truly straight
shot_plan.motion: the bronze plumb bob completes its final small oscillation while the distant capital avenue and lowered southern standard settle into alignment
shot_plan.foreground: only a low parapet edge below the waist; all people and architecture begin far behind the emperor to preserve human scale

palette_plan.dominant: cold slate blue-gray, ink-black cloth, chalk stone, pale rammed earth, oxidized river teal and one tiny muted-cinnabar southern standard
palette_plan.gold: G0 no gold leaf, gilded trim or airborne gold particles
palette_plan.light: cold clear construction-morning side light modeling the ruler's forehead planes and vertical plumb cord
palette_plan.surface: matte repaired cloth, chalky parapet stone, one taut fiber line and compressed dry-brush architectural vanishing lines

shot_plan.elevation: intimate seated eye level inside a moored Jiangdu imperial barge cabin
shot_plan.azimuth: right-front three-quarter view as he keeps a bronze mirror raised in his only visible hand and turns his eyes toward the approaching guard
shot_plan.scale: 70 mm medium-close shot from just above the knees to the complete soft headcloth; the emperor occupies about 70 percent of frame height
shot_plan.interaction: the viewer is a silent attendant at the near door-side position, sharing the instant when the emperor recognizes the guard's betrayal
shot_plan.motion: the mirror remains calm while a cold doorway draft and upright spear shadows push against the jade canal current
shot_plan.foreground: only a cropped curtain edge and low lamp plane; no cup, spill, hand or weapon enters the foreground

palette_plan.dominant: wine crimson, dark jade green, night indigo and cold blade steel
palette_plan.gold: G1 maximum 2 percent, confined to the bronze mirror rim and one small belt buckle
palette_plan.light: humid lantern red opposed by a cold steel reflection
palette_plan.surface: damp wine-crimson silk, dark lacquer, jade canal reflections and narrow cabin shadows over dry mural grain

shot_plan.elevation: level human eye height beside the Qin command position at Hulao
shot_plan.azimuth: strong left three-quarter archer view with the young prince's profile, drawing anchor, raised bow grip and normal arrow all readable
shot_plan.scale: 50 mm thigh-up environmental action portrait; Li Shimin occupies about 72 percent of frame height while the Hulao gate and two eagle pigment fields remain legible
shot_plan.interaction: the viewer stands beside the young commander at the held breath before release and follows his sightline toward the two rival forces
shot_plan.motion: the drawn bowstring stores force while the indigo and cinnabar eagle-shaped pigment currents align beyond the short arrowhead without being touched
shot_plan.foreground: only the cropped lower edge of the vermilion cape and dark armor; no second person, horse or weapon enters the lens

palette_plan.dominant: cold slate and mineral ivory, iron-blue armor, one azurite eagle field and one restrained cinnabar eagle field
palette_plan.gold: G1 maximum 2 percent, confined to dull bow and armor fasteners; no decorative gold field or uniform speckle layer
palette_plan.light: clear dry Hulao daylight models the young face, thumb-draw anchor, normal arrow and bow grip
palette_plan.surface: crisp lamellar rhythm and bow tension opposed by broad two-color eagle brush fields and chalky pass cliffs

shot_plan.elevation: extreme low view from the base of the Luoyang audience steps, looking up about 28 degrees
shot_plan.azimuth: left-facing three-quarter sovereign high in the frame, with crown-bead lines breaking the sky
shot_plan.scale: 24 mm wide medium-full view using monumental steps rather than a frontal close-up
shot_plan.interaction: the viewer is one official within the kneeling ranks and experiences the decree descending through space
shot_plan.motion: the sealed blank decree and purple-gold wheel rays descend diagonally from upper-right to lower-left, not straight at camera
shot_plan.foreground: blurred shoulders of two kneeling officials create a low human frame

palette_plan.dominant: imperial purple, dark cinnabar, ivory and deep ink-black
palette_plan.gold: G3 deliberate 8–10 percent, reserved for the geometric wheel, crown beads and decree seal; large controlled shapes, never random speckles
palette_plan.light: monumental purple-gold backlight descending along the steps
palette_plan.surface: rotating geometric rays, broad purple mineral fields and clean monumental breaks

shot_plan.elevation: eye level beside a candle in the strategy room
shot_plan.azimuth: strong right profile seen through the candle flame, with the ruler on the left third looking toward the snowy window
shot_plan.scale: 85 mm compressed close shot; shallow depth separates flame, profile, marker hand and messenger
shot_plan.interaction: the viewer is the newly arrived messenger watching the decision crystallize across the room
shot_plan.motion: snow-charged ink lines travel from the distant window toward the map while wax sparks rise vertically between viewer and face
shot_plan.foreground: large out-of-focus candle flame and wax rim partially veil the profile

palette_plan.dominant: snow cyan, candle amber, charcoal and a small oxide-red map marker
palette_plan.gold: G0 no gold leaf; warmth comes entirely from flame and wax
palette_plan.light: single amber candle against cold blue snow light
palette_plan.surface: frosted dry pigment, shallow-focus wax haze and fine wind-driven snow ink

shot_plan.elevation: ground-level battlefield camera looking up about 10 degrees
shot_plan.azimuth: front diagonal three-quarter as the emperor lunges from upper-right toward a fleeing soldier at lower-left
shot_plan.scale: 28 mm dynamic wide shot with both action vectors visible but the emperor dominant
shot_plan.interaction: the viewer occupies the wavering soldier's unstable position and is physically pulled back toward the battle
shot_plan.motion: the grab closes across the frame from right to left while whip and banners point back toward the battlefield depth
shot_plan.foreground: the fleeing soldier's cropped forearm and shield edge enter from the lower-left

palette_plan.dominant: battle dust ochre, iron blue, torn banner red and black-brown leather
palette_plan.gold: G0 no gold leaf or gilded atmosphere
palette_plan.light: hard autumn side light filtered through dust
palette_plan.surface: impact scuffs, ripped-banner strokes and diagonal dust sheets

shot_plan.elevation: eye level outside the rain-dark lattice window
shot_plan.azimuth: rear-left profile inside the room, face turned only partly toward the escaping paper
shot_plan.scale: 50 mm medium shot through the window grid, with the figure large but interrupted by architecture and rain
shot_plan.interaction: the viewer is outside in the storm where the lost poem sheet is about to pass, separated from the ruler by lattice and rain
shot_plan.motion: paper, torn silk, ink and fire-reflected rain stream sideways from the room into the night
shot_plan.foreground: wet lattice bars, rain beads and the blurred edge of the flying blank sheet

palette_plan.dominant: rain blue, pooled ink-black, wet silk white and distant fire orange
palette_plan.gold: G0 no gold leaf; distant fire supplies the only warm sparkle
palette_plan.light: cold rain foreground with unstable orange reflections from Jinling's fall
palette_plan.surface: wet paper feathering, rain beads, torn silk and diluted ink blooms

shot_plan.elevation: seated guest eye level at the banquet
shot_plan.azimuth: relaxed right three-quarter view with the emperor on the far-left third, turning across a circular table rather than facing front
shot_plan.scale: 40 mm medium-wide composition that includes neighboring generals as cropped edge silhouettes
shot_plan.interaction: the viewer is one armed founding general inside the friendly circle and senses the trap closing socially rather than physically
shot_plan.motion: cups pass around the circle while swords and loosened armor slide away laterally under the table edge
shot_plan.foreground: the viewer's cup and armored wrist remain low and off-center, never blocking the emperor's face

palette_plan.dominant: candle amber, lacquer red, deep umber and quiet sword steel
palette_plan.gold: G1 maximum 2 percent, limited to cup rim and belt fittings
palette_plan.light: warm circular banquet candlelight with a cool shadow under the table
palette_plan.surface: smoky circular brush currents, dark lacquer planes and restrained metallic edges

shot_plan.elevation: slightly high 20-degree view from behind the map platform
shot_plan.azimuth: broad rear three-quarter silhouette with the elderly face turning over the right shoulder toward the linked horizons
shot_plan.scale: 28 mm wide environmental composition; the ruler remains the largest single form while Dadu, steppe and sea unfold beyond
shot_plan.interaction: the viewer stands beside an envoy at the map edge and looks outward along the imperial network
shot_plan.motion: the relay paiza skids laterally across the map as horse-light trails radiate away toward distant roads and sea
shot_plan.foreground: map edge, saddle leather and a cropped envoy hand at rest, with no object thrown at camera

palette_plan.dominant: steppe green, sky cobalt, sea turquoise and saddle-leather brown
palette_plan.gold: G1 maximum 3 percent, aged bronze on the paiza and harness only
palette_plan.light: open panoramic daylight shifting from dry steppe to maritime haze
palette_plan.surface: wind-combed grass strokes, salt spray and long network trails across broad color fields

shot_plan.elevation: saddle-level low camera just inside the broken Hexi gate, looking up about 18 degrees
shot_plan.azimuth: front-side passing angle: horse and emperor enter from center-right and sweep past toward the left background instead of charging straight at camera
shot_plan.scale: 20 mm extreme wide action shot with gate splinters, horse body and rider face all readable
shot_plan.interaction: the viewer crouches inside the breached gate as the first cavalry rank rushes past into the fortress
shot_plan.motion: horse, lance, snow, smoke and shattered timber cut diagonally through and away from the camera position
shot_plan.foreground: broken gate beam and iron-blue snow streak across the near right edge

palette_plan.dominant: iron snow blue, smoke black, horse brown and gate-timber rust red
palette_plan.gold: G0 no gold leaf; all glints are cold iron and ice
palette_plan.light: violent blue-white snow light cut by black smoke
palette_plan.surface: splintered wood grain, ice scratches, smoke drag and diagonal cavalry impact
